title: eludite.debug.wait input
description: Wait for the debuggee to settle without driving it: until it breaks, the session ends or the program prints (`until`), at most `wait_ms`. It never resumes anything and is never refused for the mode, so it is the cheap way to wait after starting a program, after the person resumed it, or while a request you triggered runs. It answers the stop summary (debug-stop-summary.output.json) with `satisfied` naming the condition that held, or `mode` `running` and `timed_out` on a timeout; it wakes as soon as the stop is shown. Next: eludite.debug.snapshot to look closer, or a resuming command.

session.description: The debugging session to act on (brief 0028): its `id`, from eludite.debug.sessions or `sessions` in eludite.debug.state. Default: the active session, the one the Locals, Watch, Call Stack and Threads windows show and the execution point follows. The wait is satisfied by this session only. An unknown or ended id is refused with the ids of the live sessions.

until.description: `stopped`: the debuggee breaks (a stop newer than `stop` when given; at once when it is already in break mode without `stop`). `terminated`: the session ends. `output`: the program prints a new line (after `output_since` when given). `any` (default): the first of these. Every condition also ends when the session ends.

wait_ms.description: How long to wait, in milliseconds (default 5000, at most 30000).

stop.description: The stop the caller saw: `stopped` then waits for a newer one. Never refused for being old.

depth.description: How many levels of the locals to expand: 1 (default) lists the top level only; up to 5. Expansion is breadth-first and stops when `max_variables` rows are listed.

max_variables.description: The most variable rows listed, counting every level (default 50, at most 500).

max_value_chars.description: Values longer than this are cut and end with `… (N chars)`, the row saying `value_truncated` (default 200, at most 10000).

max_frames.description: The most stack frames listed (default 10, at most 200); page further with eludite.debug.stack.

max_output_lines.description: The most program output lines listed (default 20, at most 1000; 0 lists none).

output_since.description: An output cursor (`output.next` of an earlier answer, or eludite.debug.output's `next`): list the program's lines from it on. Default: the last `max_output_lines` lines.
